changes.title: Challenge area
items: Each island now has a challenge area at the end of the footpaths: a wide stone circle with the island's glowing sigil and a ring of columns, the forest close around it, guarded by an adult and a youth of every animal on the island

Win every one of them over (or see them off), then hold E in the middle of the circle to cast the music spell: a dancefloor like the one at home fills the circle, lit on the beat, the animals dance on it, and the columns fire fireworks one after another round the ring, a bar at a time
Tonight's find then comes down from the sky onto the dancefloor for you to pick up; once you've found everything, a flask comes down instead
Challenges are optional and stay open until the night is won or lost

changes.title: Colour grammar
items: New colours: the party is warm and the forest is cold. Your sigils, chains and runes are pink, crimson, orange and gold by rank; wild ones are purple, blue and turquoise. Every baby is pink, and a sleeping legend a pale lilac.
Berries are a deep berry pink, and the ley line ahead of its spark is a cold rainbow of blue, purple and turquoise. Red now means a warning.
The pause page's Colours switch brings back the old colours to compare.

changes.title: Steady tempo
items: The night's tempo stays the same from wave to wave: your record's BPM (120 with none), so the spark keeps one speed all night
Only being knocked down speeds the beat up now; the music's style still changes every wave
Music Lab: the tempo ramp knob is gone, and the style shows one BPM for every wave

changes.title: Chain rework
items: Every animal on your leash is on an 80 m chain. Pull it taut and you drag it: youths slow you a little, adults a lot, and a legend stops you
Only adults and legends stop you taking off now; youths never do. Try anyway and their chains rattle
Your followers no longer weigh you down: no more slower rising or being pulled out of the sky
Chains lie on the ground at full length, invisible close by and glowing as they pull taut
